source_issues.summary: Poultry manure deferred pending attributable fraction/graphics clarification or independent primary evidence.

selection: Five records extend distinct evidence boundaries: ludlamite thermal oxidation; paracoquimbite abiotic synthesis; regerite natural-crystal identity and structure; szomolnokite as a transient sulfate hydrate; and ponded mixed coal ash as a secondary resource with culture-associated metal mobilization. Shared-study mineral arms are explicitly not independent replications. No constituent criticality, isolated-product yield or industrial deployment is inherited.
validation: Baseline and final just check passed (317 tests, 3 skipped). Strict nonempty corpus validation, append-only history, generated pages and canonical structured reviews passed. Every new owner has an independent scientific review matching its final ID, path and byte hash. No schema, validator, test or governed-file changes were needed.
remaining_priorities: Poultry manure remains deferred under issue #358: reconcile treatment labels, contradictory graphics, fraction denominators and mass accounting, or acquire independent complete primary evidence. Poultry litter and poultry-bone residues remain distinct.
Acquire the paracoquimbite supplementary deposit before asserting detailed coordinate reproducibility. Retain hydration and entropy-model limits.
Acquire the 2019 coal-ash kinetics original and establish experimental lineage and feed identity before any additional mechanism or pure-bottom-ash claim.
Preserve mixed-feed, chemical-acid and missing-control limits in ponded coal ash; published percentages and modeled optimization are not validated isolated-product yields.

Continue bounded source discovery. Oily-sludge hydrocarbon degradation and abiotic stone-wool processing leads do not establish microbial metal recovery; this batch does not demonstrate exhaustion of new CMMs.
Verify PR-shepherd credentials and perform a controlled dry run through supported CLAW processes; the observed run count remains zero.
scope_limits: Local curation and independent review complete; hosted PR, native queue and fresh-main checks remain publication gates. Raw originals remain outside Git. No source-exhaustion claim.
